classes.disposition: Still open at final closing commit 6d0072a7db4aafd414bbe21ee5fbdc74a580cdc7. src/merger-role.ts:31 registers the closed mergerOutputSchema as the tool transport parameters, while the aborting catch exists only inside execute at lines 32-40. Pi validates arguments before execute (installed pi-agent-core agent-loop.js:393-405); validation exceptions become an immediate ordinary isError result at lines 441-446, so execute and host.failInfrastructure are never reached. Mechanical confirmation on current HEAD: typebox Value.Check rejects both the missing-diagnosis payload used by test/merger-role.test.ts and an unknown-key payload. The added test calls tool.execute directly and therefore bypasses this production seam. Make transport admission broad enough for malformed Merger candidate objects to reach the existing exact runtime validator/fatal-abort seam (without weakening the exported/accepted contract or adding a parallel mechanism), and add an integration-level regression that traverses Pi's argument validation/execution path and proves a schema-invalid Merger submission aborts/nonzero rather than yielding a recoverable tool error or another attempt.
